meta.title: perf: optimize O(n²) algorithms in slot generation
meta.body_summary: Replace several O(n²) algorithms in cal.com slot generation with O(n) or O(n log n) solutions using Maps and loop restructuring to improve performance for large numbers of slots and bookings.

perf_labels.notes: Devin optimized slot generation by replacing nested loops with Maps; approved by two reviewers with manual seat testing and E2E CI; merged cleanly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 196 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted algorithmic optimization performance PR that merged after two approvals with no blocking concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer joeauyeung approved with comment 'Code LGTM and seats are working as expected'; second reviewer hbjORbj approved without text.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced time complexity from O(n²) to O(n) using Maps, claimed to improve performance for large numbers of slots/bookings.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin successfully refactored existing JS/TS algorithms using Maps to reduce complexity; the change is within its capability for data structure transformations and the reviewers accepted the code after manual testing and CI.

detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions ran E2E tests and posted results link; no failures reported.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes algorithmic changes and testing steps, but no before/after performance benchmarks; review focused on correctness.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR was merged after approvals without any revert or follow-up fix.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots/util.ts, replaced countBy with Map, moved reduce outside map, and used Maps for lookups instead of nested some/findIndex; merged main brought slot test and performance-related adjustments in lib.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit added test file and performance-related changes in slots.ts, likely corresponding to the optimization.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: optimize O(n²) algorithms with Maps, reduce operations outside loops.
Merge main bringing additional test and performance tweaks.
Two APPROVED reviews; merged without inline review comments.
